steps.name: keyword-search-without-fake-embedding
steps.summary: The current public route now uses the native keyword fallback without a fake embedding adapter, budget lookup, or usage row, while preserving the optional real-provider budget/ledger contract.

steps.name: guard-before-public-store-load
steps.summary: Evaluate short, abnormal, duplicate, and rate-limited queries before loading the PostgreSQL-backed public store, without weakening cached-result retraction filtering.

steps.name: submitted-query-ui-consistency
steps.summary: Keep the visible search term and rendered result set tied to the same submitted query while an earlier request is in flight.
